# LabReserve coding-agent instructions

Use the repository policy in the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical source of instructions.

Keep changes within the requested scope, report checks truthfully, protect secrets, and leave commits, pushes, pull requests, destructive actions, permissions, secrets, and repository settings to the human maintainer unless explicitly authorized. Do not add AI or service identities, agent attribution, or generated coverage artifacts unless the canonical policy and the request permit them.
